hero.headline: Sowing Into Communities. *Strengthening* Those Who Serve.
hero.subtext: The AH Foundation partners with faith-based and nonprofit organizations that are creating meaningful change in the lives of individuals, families, and communities. We believe meaningful impact happens through partnership.

why.heading: Business Success. Community Impact.
paragraphs: The AH Foundation was established from a belief that success creates both an opportunity and a responsibility to give back.

As INTEGRITY grows and serves customers in communities across the country, the AH Foundation seeks opportunities to invest back into those communities by supporting organizations already making a meaningful difference.
Rather than simply providing funding, the Foundation seeks to develop meaningful relationships with organizations that understand their communities and are creating lasting impact.

values.heading: The Values Behind Every Partnership
values.intro: Four commitments shape how the AH Foundation identifies, builds, and sustains relationships with the organizations we support.

items.title: Faith
items.text: Supporting organizations whose work reflects compassion, service, and Christian values.

items.title: Community
items.text: Investing in organizations addressing meaningful needs within the communities they serve.

items.title: Partnership
items.text: Building relationships with organizations rather than simply providing financial support.

items.title: Impact
items.text: Measuring success by lasting change in the lives of individuals, families, and communities.

stories_section.intro: A look at current partnerships and outreach efforts demonstrating the Foundation's work in real communities.

partners_section.heading: Organizations We're Privileged to Serve Alongside
partners_section.intro: A glimpse at the faith-based and nonprofit organizations partnering with the AH Foundation. Visit the full directory to see every partner.

closing.heading: We Believe Meaningful Impact Happens Through Partnership.
closing.text: By investing in trusted organizations, building lasting relationships, and supporting work already changing lives, we can accomplish more together.
